name: ticktick-mcp
description: Provides access to TickTick task management via the v2 API: create, update, complete, move, delete, and filter tasks, manage subtasks, retrieve completed tasks within a date range, and track which completions have been processed by an agent. Features field-preserving partial updates, day-of-week date validation, read-after-write verification, and idempotent completion tracking backed by local SQLite.
